meta.description: Registry for residue-balance failure modes in Phase 3 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: unbounded_residue_amplification
failure_modes.description: Total residue grows without bound under recursive coupling or iteration.

failure_modes.name: false_conservation
failure_modes.description: Residue is declared conserved when formal measure leakage or gain exists.

failure_modes.name: residue_loss_untracked
failure_modes.description: Residue is lost in formal derivation or transport without a registered dissipative rule.

failure_modes.name: non_conservative_transport
failure_modes.description: NavT transport fails to preserve or bound the total residue measure within its domain.

failure_modes.name: saturation_collapse
failure_modes.description: Residue saturation results in the collapse of the admissibility window or continuation selection.

failure_modes.name: residue_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Distinct residue histories map to indistinguishable formal balance metrics.

failure_modes.name: source_sink_imbalance
failure_modes.description: Residue accumulation rate permanently exceeds dissipation rate in a recurrence cycle.

failure_modes.name: residue_equivalence_failure
failure_modes.description: Preservation of residue equivalence class fails under operator application.

failure_modes.name: residue_drift_beyond_tolerance
failure_modes.description: Residue state deviates outside the bounds required for stable theorem application.

failure_modes.name: global_conservation_overclaim
failure_modes.description: Local or conditional conservation is incorrectly promoted to universal or physical status.
